definitions.full_reference: Same1024-particle finite-SNIS estimate; not exact truth.
definitions.blocks: Four disjoint consecutive256-particle blocks, same source features/factors; each shares observations with the full1024 estimate.
definitions.cohort: Original9 and added6 are selected training diagnostic states, not independent validation; no significance inference from the block comparisons.
definitions.normalized_scale: 1 + L2 norm of the full1024 gradient over all190 coordinates.
definitions.zero_signal: Exactly zero computed L2 norm; no fitted near-zero threshold.
definitions.failure_statistics: No finite-subset replacement of failed full/block comparisons.

scope: Posthoc sampling-noise and reweighting description only; no new threshold, coefficient choice or training admission.
